newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan bullion prices rebound above world benchmark.
newsitem.headline: Japan bullion prices rebound above world benchmark.

text.p: Gold bullion prices in the Tokyo spot market rebounded above world benchmark London, or loco London, as demand from the jewellery sector shows signs of improving slightly, traders said on Thursday.
Japan's spot bullion prices were currently quoted at 40 to 50 U.S. cents an ounce over loco London, having recovered from about 30 cent discounts in mid-September.
Bullion prices have been flat to discounted from loco London since early September as the market suffered from fragile demand.

"Gold bullion prices have recovered to a premium since earlier this week from slight discounts as moderate fresh demand emerged ahead of the Christmas and year-end gift-giving season. It appears inventories are falling gradually," an official of a bullion house said.

Traders said, however, demand from the jewellery sector was still lower than usual levels, adding that demand from the investment sector remained depressed due mainly to the yen's weaker tone against the dollar, which pushes up domestic retail prices.
